what_it_does: Builds a compiler pipeline that lets HPC researchers write parallel Fortran code and automatically accelerate it on field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs)—specialized chips that can be reconfigured to perform specific tasks faster than general-purpose processors. The compiler reads Fortran code, uses OpenMP directives to identify which parts should run on FPGAs, transforms the code through an intermediate representation (MLIR), and produces designs suitable for FPGA synthesis and implementation.
